blocks.text: Welcome to the Riftbound: Radiance overview. Here you’ll find key dates, new mechanics, collectibility details, and product highlights as preview season rolls on.
This is the last update to this article and we now have the full picture of Radiance! We can’t wait to catch y’all at the Pre-Rifts!
Radiance is about performing like a master: playing at the absolute peak of your powers, under the brightest lights, with everything on the line.
With a lineup of some of the best bands in the League of Legends universe and a colorful cast of new legends, Radiance is sure to dazzle.
Check out our Dev Video for a snapshot of this set, and Dave’s deep and unbridled love for Karaoke.
Drawing Selection Begins: October 5, 2026 at approximately 9:00 AM Pacific Time
English, French, and Chinese languages release
Play this Gear only to a Battlefield and it will grant benefits while there. When an opponent holds that Battlefield, kill this Gear.
Reveal, or “Show Off,” a qualifying card from your hand or on your board to unlock a new effect of the played card.
Disarm reduces the Might of an enemy Unit by as you attack!
Disarm is similar to Assault. Each instance of Disarm will make its Might reduction stronger.
Gear Units were introduced in Vendetta with the Patched Porobot. With Orianna’s Legend effect, equipment can now become Units as well.
Before you get too excited about equipping Units onto one another— when an Equipment becomes a Unit, it’s automatically unequipped.
Bombs are small gifts to leave your opponent! The more bombs you play, the bigger the boom.
Radiance brings Riftbound’s second Ultimate Rare.

We learned a lot with the Ultimate Rare introduced in Unleashed. While finding one was very exciting, it wasn’t quite as rare as we wanted it to be. We're trying something new with this card: it's our rarest Ultimate Rare yet, significantly harder to find than the Baron.
Each Riftbound: Radiance booster pack contains:
1 Foil slot that can be a Common, Uncommon, Rare or Epic
1 slot that can be a Rare, Epic, Alt Art, Special Alt, Overnumber, or Ultimate Rare
1 Token, Rune, or Alt Art Rune

Each pack can contain at most one Ultimate Rare card. There is no guaranteed Ultimate Rare in any pack, box, or case. On average across the entire Radiance print run, an Ultimate Rare appears in approximately 0.025% of booster packs. Pack contents are randomized during manufacturing. Any stated appearance rates reflect averages across the print run and are not guarantees of appearance in booster packs or booster displays.

Our Crystal Rose themed Special cards introduced in Vendetta were extremely popular, and we know you’re all wanting more. So I’ll show you what we’ve got in store—we couldn’t have a music themed set without featuring the K/DA girls.
As a reminder, Special Alt Art Cards appear at roughly the same frequency as Alt Art cards.
In Radiance, we have the nine new Legends in the set represented with their Overnumbered variants, which can be found with an artist's signature as well.
The boys are here with a modern fashion makeover. Collect them all and stun your opponent with your overwhelming aura.

The Ultimate Rare for Radiance is going to be even rarer than the Unleashed Baron, and we’re trying something new with our first showcase Battlefield also being an Ultimate Rare. This picture doesn’t quite do it justice, but we’re excited for players to share the moment someone pulls it.
This new set has some musically inspired Runes. Check them out below!
With Radiance, Ekko and Seraphine take center stage in this stunning new box art, with Ziggs and Jarvan playing supporting roles.
Seraphine’s bright and bubbly performance clashes with Evelynn’s seductive sultry tones.
Check back later in previews for decklists once the cards have been revealed!
